name: mental-model-diagramming
description: Indi Young-style mental model diagramming. Captures user thinking / feelings / actions around a problem domain, grouped into 'towers' (task spaces) with supporting features below. Produces ground-level rows (user behaviors + reactions + guiding principles) + feature-alignment rows (existing + proposed + gap). Distinct from empathy mapping (domain-level, not individual). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
